title: Fix component styles in fumadocs and add automated testing
body:
ObjectUI component demos in fumadocs were unstyled due to missing Tailwind v4 theme configuration. ## Changes - **Added `@source` directives** for Tailwind v4 to scan ObjectUI workspace packages: ```css @source '../../packages/components/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'; @source '../../packages/react/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'; @source '../../packages/plugin-*/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'; ``` - **Migrated Shadcn design tokens** from `@object-ui/components` to Tailwind v4 syntax: - Converted `@layer base` → plain CSS custom properties - Converted `@apply` → explicit CSS rules - Maintained light/dark theme variables (`:root`, `.dark`) - **Created `tailwind.config.ts`** to map CSS custom properties to Tailwind utilities: - Maps CSS variables (`--primary`, `--destructive`, etc.) to Tailwind color utilities (`bg-primary`, `text-destructive`) - Configures theme extensions for border-radius using CSS variables - Ensures component classes resolve to actual color values - **Added automated component style testing infrastructure**: - `scripts/test-component-styles.js`: Comprehensive Playwright-based test script that validates CSS properties across 15+ components - `scripts/test-component-styles.sh`: Wrapper script with automatic server start/stop - `scripts/README.md`: Complete documentation with usage examples and troubleshooting - Tests background colors, borders, padding, and other CSS properties - Captures screenshots for visual verification - Provides detailed error reports with severity levels - CI-ready with appropriate exit codes ## Context The site uses Tailwind v4 while `@object-ui/components` is built with v3. Tailwind v4 requires explicit theme configuration to map CSS variables to utility classes. Without this mapping, classes like `bg-primary` couldn't resolve to the actual color values, causing components to render without styles. ## Testing Run the automated test suite: ```bash # With dev server ./scripts/test-component-styles.sh dev # With production build ./scripts/test-component-styles.sh build ``` The test script validates styling across all component categories and reports any issues with specific CSS properties. ## Screenshots **Before - Missing styles:** **After - Properly styled components:** **Components gallery:** **Date Picker with Calendar:** **Calendar Popup:**
